title: Une salle, puis une autre
summary: Lina arrives for an evening workshop, discovers a last-minute room change and helps the group get started.

sentences.fr: Lina avait réservé sa soirée pour un atelier de conversation au centre communautaire.
sentences.en: Lina had set aside her evening for a conversation workshop at the community centre.

sentences.fr: Avant de partir, elle avait lu l'ancien avis, qui indiquait la salle 204.
sentences.en: Before leaving, she had read the old notice, which listed room 204.

sentences.fr: En arrivant, elle a vu un petit message à l'entrée : le groupe devait se réunir au troisième étage, dans la salle 308.
sentences.en: When she arrived, she saw a short message at the entrance: the group was to meet in room 308 on the third floor.

sentences.fr: L'organisatrice avait prévenu les participants par courriel, mais Lina n'avait pas vu le message.
sentences.en: The organizer had notified participants by email, but Lina had not seen the message.

sentences.fr: Comme plusieurs personnes attendaient devant l'ancienne salle, Lina leur a montré le nouvel avis.
sentences.en: Since several people were waiting outside the old room, Lina showed them the new notice.

sentences.fr: Le groupe a commencé avec quinze minutes de retard, sans perdre la séance entière.
sentences.en: The group started fifteen minutes late without losing the whole session.

sentences.fr: Après l'atelier, l'organisatrice a promis de confirmer l'heure et la salle dans un seul message.
sentences.en: After the workshop, the organizer promised to confirm the time and room in one message.
sentences.note: A useful confirmation puts the date, time and location together, so readers do not have to combine details from several messages.

quiz.prompt: What had Lina read before leaving?
options: A notice about a new date
quiz.explain: The second sentence says the old notice listed room 204.

quiz.prompt: Why had Lina missed the update?
options: She had not seen the organizer's email
She had gone to the wrong centre
The organizer had sent no message
quiz.explain: The organizer had emailed the change, but Lina had not seen the message.

quiz.prompt: What improvement did the organizer promise?
options: Confirm the time and room in one message
Move every meeting to another centre
Ask Lina to lead the next session
quiz.explain: The final sentence states the organizer would put the time and room in one message.
